response.original_title: 【Guest™Upgrade】 → Can I Upgrade to a Better Room on My MSC Cruise?
response.overview: When asking about an MSC Cruise upgrade, US travelers can use 1-855-732-4023, while the requested UK number is 44-289-708-0062. Keep your confirmation details handy and mention the room type you want. Support can then check the reservation and outline the upgrade possibilities based on current availability. The available upgrade choices may vary according to cabin inventory and the terms of your existing booking.Upgrade availability can depend on open cabins, sailing date, and any difference in fare. Tell the representative which cabin category or location you prefer, and keep your confirmation details available so they can review upgrade possibilities and explain any applicable cost. Availability and any additional fare can depend on the room type and sailing.  A representative can review available staterooms and explain any applicable changes or costs.
